    Super Bowl LXI on Disney+

    In 2027, the Super Bowl will air on Disney+ and ESPN for the first time in history. The occasion will also mark the first Super Bowl on ABC since 2006. Learn more here.

    • The Game

      Super Bowl LXI will be played on Feb. 14, 2027 at SoFi Stadium in Inglewood, CA.

    • How to Watch

      Super Bowl LXI will air on Disney+ and will also be available on ESPN and ABC. You can stream on Disney+ with a Disney+ or bundle subscription, as well as on the ESPN app with plans that include ESPN Unlimited.

    • Halftime Show Performer

      See Jay-Z take the stage for the Apple Music Super Bowl LXI Halftime Show.

    Frequently Asked Questions

    What is ESPN Unlimited? How is it different from ESPN Select (formerly ESPN+)?

    ESPN Unlimited is a direct-to-consumer streaming service that allows you to stream all ESPN networks, including ESPN, ESPN2, ESPNU, SEC Network, ACC Network, ESPNEWS, ESPN Deportes - in addition to ESPN on ABC, ESPN+, SEC Network+, ACC Network Extra, and now NFL Network. With ESPN Unlimited you can watch sports like NFL, NBA, NHL, MLB, tennis and golf majors, WWE, WWE NXT, NASCAR, SEC, ACC and Big 12 football and basketball. Subscribers also get postseason coverage from the NFL, NBA, WNBA, NHL, College Football Playoff, and more, as well as studio shows like SportsCenter, First Take and College GameDay.

    ESPN Select plan subscribers have access to ESPN+, with top-tier soccer, PGA TOUR, NHL, college sports, and a selection of other ESPN programming. 

    There are two available bundle plans – ESPN Select and ESPN Unlimited. Disney+ offers both within the following bundle plans: 

    Disney+, Hulu, ESPN Unlimited Bundle for the price of $35.99/month, which includes Disney+ (With Ads), Hulu (With Ads), and ESPN Unlimited (With Ads). 

    Disney+, Hulu, ESPN Unlimited Bundle Premium for the price of $44.99/month, which includes Disney+ (No Ads*), Hulu (No Ads*), and ESPN Unlimited (With Ads). 

    Disney+, Hulu, ESPN Select Bundle for the price of $21.99/month, which includes Disney+ (With Ads), Hulu (With Ads), and ESPN Select (With Ads). 

    Disney+, Hulu, ESPN Select Bundle Premium for the price of $32.99/month, which includes Disney+ (No Ads*), Hulu (No Ads*), and ESPN Select (With Ads).

    *Ads will be served in select live and linear content for all Disney+ plans. Titles without ratings like live sports, news, and more, and the advertisements included therein, may feature mature themes, products, and services.

    What is Disney+ and how much does it cost?

    Disney+ is a streaming service where you can watch movies, series, and originals from Disney, Pixar, Marvel, Star Wars, National Geographic, and more.
    Access unlimited entertainment with Disney+ or Disney+ Premium in the United States:

    • Disney+: Disney+ (With Ads) for the price of $12.49/month

    • Disney+ Premium: Disney+ (No Ads*) for the price of $21.49/month or $214.99/year

    Save over 16%** on Disney+ Premium (No Ads) with an annual plan for $214.99/year

    *Ads will be served in select live and linear content.
    **Savings compared to 12 months of the monthly price of Disney+ Premium (No Ads).

    What can I watch on Disney+ and where can I watch Disney+?

    Disney+ is the streaming home for entertainment from Disney, Pixar, Marvel, Star Wars, National Geographic, Hulu, ESPN Select and more. With Disney+, you can choose from an always-growing collection of stories.

    • New releases and timeless classics

    • Exclusive new Original Movies and Series

    • A limited selection of hit Hulu series and movies in the Hulu hub on Disney+.

    • Select live sports, studio shows, and more from ESPN Select in the all-new ESPN hub in Disney+

    • Exciting specials and limited-time streaming events

    • Nostalgic throwbacks and past seasons of your favorite shows

    • The entire Skywalker Saga and much of the Marvel Cinematic Universe

    • Beloved and experimental shorts

    • Documentaries, unscripted series, and so much more

    The Disney+ app is available on mobile devices, web browsers, game consoles, set-top boxes, and smart TVs. Click to view a complete list of supported devices.

    What are the different bundle plans available and how much do they cost? What additional plan offerings can I choose from?

    Bundle plans include subscriptions to either Disney+ and Hulu, or Disney+, Hulu, and ESPN Unlimited, at discounted prices, as compared to the retail price of each subscription when purchased separately. Available to customers in the United States.

    Choose between the following bundle plans:

    • Disney+, Hulu Bundle for $12.99/mo or $11.99/mo for the first 6 months**, which includes Disney+ (With Ads) and Hulu (With Ads)

    • Disney+, Hulu Bundle Premium for $21.99/mo or $19.99/mo for the first 6 months**, which includes Disney+ (No Ads*) and Hulu (No Ads*)

    • Disney+, Hulu, ESPN Unlimited Bundle for $35.99/month which includes Disney+ (With Ads), Hulu (With Ads), and ESPN (With Ads) 

    • Disney+, Hulu, ESPN Unlimited Bundle Premium for $44.99/month, which includes Disney+ (No Ads*), Hulu (No Ads*), and ESPN (With Ads) 

    **Cost for Disney+, Hulu Bundle for 6 months: $71.94, then renews to monthly plan at $12.99/month. Cost for Disney+, Hulu Bundle Premium for 6 months: $119.94, then renews to monthly plan at $21.99/month. Cancel anytime. If cancelled during the initial 6 month term, effective at the end of your 6 month term; if cancelled after initial term, effective at the end of your monthly billing period.

    Additionally, you may also like the following plan offerings:

    1. Hulu + Live TV plans

    • Hulu + Live TV, Disney+ and ESPN Select for $99.99/month

    • Hulu Premium + Live TV, Disney+ Premium and ESPN Select for $109.99/month

    The Hulu + Live TV plans include 95+ live TV channels and additional on-demand content from your favorite sports, entertainment, and news channels you can watch at home or on-the-go. You will also get access to the content from Disney+, Hulu and ESPN Select streaming libraries. Access content from each service separately. Learn more and sign up here.

    2. Disney+, Hulu, HBO Max Bundle

    Disney+, Hulu, HBO Max Bundle plans include subscriptions to Disney+, Hulu, and HBO Max, at discounted prices, as compared to the monthly retail price of each subscription when purchased separately. Currently, there is no annual subscription for the Disney+, Hulu, HBO Max Bundle.

    Choose between the following Disney+, Hulu, HBO Max Bundle Plans:

    • Disney+, Hulu, HBO Max Bundle (With Ads) for $21.99/month, savings of more than $13 per month. This plan includes Disney+, Hulu, and HBO Max all with ads.

    • Disney+, Hulu, HBO Max Bundle (No Ads) for $34.99/month, savings of $26 per month. This plan includes Disney+, Hulu, and HBO Max all without ads. Ads will be served in select live and linear content.

    With Disney+, you get new releases, classics, series, and Originals from Disney, Pixar, Marvel, Star Wars, and National Geographic.

    With Hulu, you can enjoy current hits, comfort classics, award-winning Originals, and movies like FX’s The Bear and The Kardashians.

    With HBO Max, stream all of HBO, the DC universe, and new releases from Warner Bros. and A2 — including House of the Dragon, The Pitt, Harry Potter, and Friends. The Disney+, Hulu, HBO Max Bundle (No Ads*) plan goes further with thousands of live sports events — from MLB™, NHL, NCAA®, March Madness®, U.S Soccer, and more — with pre- and post-game studio programming, Multiview experiences, and more exclusive features.

    *Live Sports on HBO Max has select games available and blackouts may apply. Terms apply. Ads will be served in select live and linear content

    How and where can I access Hulu titles on Disney+?

    If you’re a Disney+ subscriber in the United States, you can stream a limited selection of Hulu titles on Disney+. Access the Hulu hub on the Disney+ homepage to preview the Hulu on Disney+ experience.

    If you’re a bundle subscriber or you subscribe to both Disney+ and Hulu (as standalone services with the same email address), you can stream a more extensive collection of Hulu titles on Disney+. You can use the Hulu hub on the Disney+ homepage to jump right into streaming some of your favorite Hulu Originals, series, and more. Click to view a list of supported devices.

    Eligible Disney+ and Hulu subscribers can watch a wide variety of Hulu’s streaming library on Disney+. Certain Hulu titles are available only via the Hulu app. In addition, the Hulu app will continue to be the streaming destination for Hulu’s entire streaming library, all Hulu premium add-on content as well as any content associated with a Live TV subscription.

    How and where can I access ESPN on Disney+?

    Subscribers with any linked ESPN plan can now stream live content from ESPN on Disney+.

    Once accounts are linked, to access ESPN content on Disney+, follow these steps:

    • Open the Disney+ app or website

    • Choose the ESPN icon on the Disney+ homepage to enter the ESPN hub

    • You can also find select ESPN content by using the Search feature or by browsing the different rows on the Disney+ homepage.

    • Once you’re in the ESPN hub, you can filter through Sports, Teams, Leagues, and Tournament pages. You can also search for any of those categories. Note — the sports content available to you to depends on your plan.

    Not sure if your accounts are linked? You can learn about how you can authenticate with your pay-tv provider here.

    What are Playlists on Disney+?

    Playlists are a new way to discover and watch content on Disney+. Each Playlist is a curated collection of movies and episodes grouped around a theme, franchise, character, genre, or mood, making it easy to jump right into something you'll enjoy. Simply select a Playlist and let the content play continuously, with the flexibility to pause, skip and rewind. Playlists can be found on the Disney+ Home.

    What happened to Streams?

    In the U.S., Playlists are replacing Streams, while ABC News will remain available as a livestream experience.
